help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to use the client portal for your IP portfolio.
help.enquiriesBody: Use Enquiries to submit a new matter request. The firm will review conflict checks and convert approved leads into matters.
help.approvalsBody: When the firm requests your approval (for example renewals or instructions), respond from the Approvals page.
help.contactBody: Contact your assigned attorney or coordinator through Messages, or reply to firm correspondence on a matter.
